record: Shared57 Act3 archived portrait startup versus Act2 checkpoint source origin comparison

source_facts.fact: The exact saved-portrait selector sets paused true and dispatches directly to the archive reader. It does not enter ordinary open_regular/Main combat setup.
The selected path writes the exact archived session into isolated Store, constructs the public Shell through _c50_new_shell, awaits startup, and only afterward requests Continue.
The branch instantiates ProductionShell directly and requires no Main donor/Player/level/Scheduler from a live recreation.
The inherited public startup barrier reads error/status after process frames and requires exact expected Attempts state before Continue.
Existing disk plus opt-in capability makes Shell._ready latch draining and defer _finish_startup_load; that awaits _prepare_registration with default empty arguments before attempts.load_saved.
The checkpoint fixture starts an actual installed Story Hero, resumes to stable support, then uses public request_pause, public host checkpoint, and another public pause.
Public Pause uses _enqueue then deferred _drain/_commit_drain/_perform/_record_live. _record_live captures the actual installed donor and passes that complete snapshot as extra to preparation.

The common donor guard adds complete Player and native level capture rows only if those installed objects are valid; it always retains native camera/input bytes. Title startup and installed-donor pause therefore have different captured row content.

Nonpreview Shell processing returns while Player is absent or registration is inflight; idle Title focus notifications do not request pause without an active level. The selected nonpreview path does not call Game._ready/preview reset.

Both origins execute the same paused-frame custody predicate. After the actual process_frame await, OR order is tree paused, process frame advanced, internal elapsed bound, disk string, donor string, Attempts string. Later comparisons short-circuit if an earlier operand fails.

limits: No raw log, result, archive payload or native bank was opened; sibling owns the separate closed-packet comparison.
